turns.prompt: {D}/words.txt has 50,000 lines with many duplicates. Write the unique lines, sorted, one per line, to {D}/unique.txt and tell me how many unique lines there are.
turns.verify: f={D}/unique.txt; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no unique.txt; exit 0; }; n=$(wc -l < $f); s=$(sha256sum $f | cut -d' ' -f1); echo "SHOW lines=$n sha=$s"; echo PASS
